title: Jimmy Savile at Chequers and the hospital key

tellings.quote:
Jimmy Savile was so influential in the
UK that he was spending his Christmases
at checkers where the prime minister
would spend it

plain: Jimmy Savile, a famous British television presenter, is said to have been so influential that he spent his Christmases at Chequers, the British prime minister's country house, where the prime minister also spent them. Jay Anderson, a guest on an episode about secret networks of power, passes this on. He tells it to show how close Savile was to the very top of British life.
